question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fastidious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Lax**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fastidious"** means very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail. (अतिसंवेदनशील)

 
 
• **Example:** She was fastidious about her appearance, always making sure her clothes were perfectly pressed and her hair impeccably styled.
 
 
 
• **"Lax"** refers to not sufficiently strict, severe, or careful. (ढीला)
 
 
• **Example:** The lax security at the event made it easy for unauthorized persons to enter.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Fastidious'** is **'Lax'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Lax.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Speedy** (तेज़): Moving or capable of moving at high speed.

 
 
• **Example:** The speedy delivery service ensured that the package arrived the next day.
 
 
 
• **Late** (देर): Doing something or taking place after the expected, proper, or usual time.
 
 
• **Example:** He was late for the meeting because of heavy traffic.
 
 
 
• **Scrupulous** (ईमानदार): Very concerned to avoid doing wrong; extremely attentive to details.
 
 
• **Example:** The scrupulous accountant made sure every entry was accurate and justified.
